fixed.what: deleteRoom now checks roomDeleteBlock (the room's maker, the design's maker, an Owner or an Admin) and refuses with ROOM_RULE. Each EditorRoom carries mayDelete (the reason, or null) plus createdBy, so the menu can say why.
restoreRoom goes through roomFor(deleted:true) with the same room rule and returns { ok } | Err. Before, it was a bare update with no visibility check.

Server side: a deleted version, or one in a deleted room, is dropped from the client link and counted in PublicShare.gone. Every client action refuses it. If nothing is left, the link ends (ended 'versions'). restoreVersion returns { ok } | Err, and version_deleted/restored events are logged. The Deleted-versions sheet can list versions[roomId].filter(v => v.deleted). The confirm dialog and hint copy are UI (wave B).

renameRoom refuses a name another live room already has, ignoring case ('There’s already a room called X.'). Past 60 characters it refuses instead of cutting. An unchanged name is a no-op. renameDesign refuses past 80. addRoom now also de-duplicates ignoring case. The TextField maxLength is UI.

setRoomPhoto keeps the room as it was (photo, sampleKey, sourceFileId, detection, picks) in project_rooms.prior_photo_json. New undoRoomPhoto(roomId) puts it all back and returns imageUrl, detection, pending and stateRev. It refuses once renders of the new photo exist. saveRender clears the saved copy.

readShareLink/fetchShare treat a deleted design as a stopped link: state 'stopped', ended 'design', with no versions, pins or notes in the payload. openLink refuses every client write with the stopped wording, and stampShareView skips it. Restore reopens the link.

Same fix as F092. Also, a lead that is returned to Qanvast (return processing or approved) or deleted ends its links (ended 'lead'). A rejected return or Undo reopens them. Links are judged when read, so no hooks were needed in app/leads/actions.ts or return-actions.ts.

fileVersion copies a stored picture into lead_file_images and points thumb at /files/img/<file>. deleteDesignsForever first gives any render filed from those designs its own copy (adoptFiledRenders), then logs a design_purged lead event. The file survives and Activity keeps a line.

New lead_file_renders table records which version each filed render is (file_id, render_key, design_id, room_id, n). fileVersion writes it, duplicateFiles copies it, and repair R62 backfills it. lib/leads/files.ts exposes renders: Record<fileId, RenderOrigin> (and render for the viewer), and queries.ts has renderOrigin(s). leadImages no longer offers filed renders as room photos. A column on lead_files was avoided because it would break `satisfies LeadFile` literals in files nobody owns.

One line per surface group and finish, with a count (quoteLines). Each line is priced from the Price book item its studio material names (lib:<id>, shaded variants included), otherwise from an item with the same name, otherwise S$0. There is no category fallback. editorData.quotable plus isPriced let the dialog say 'n of m priced'.

addVersionToQuote builds its lines from the version's cumulative finishes (quoteLines over finishes.surfaces and customised pieces not taken out), so a relit version quotes its walls, floor and sofa. A version with no finishes gets 'This version has no finishes to quote yet.'
addVersionToQuote(…, again = false) refuses a version already in that draft ('V{n} is already in that quote.'). editorData.quotes[].versions lists the visualizer sections each draft already holds.

Line names use the dialog's words ('Grey Fabric Sofa — Emerald Velvet', 'Walls — Sage Green'). The description is now the Price book item's own description or empty. The 'From the AI Visualizer: <detection label>' wording no longer prints.

The bell's href for a favourite, note, pin or reply is /visualizer/<design>?room=&v=[&pin=]&from=…. Activity's viz() links carry room, version and pin for render, favourite, note, pin and reply lines. Repair R62 rewrites the demo's nine bell entries.

askCallBack requires a valid number only when the link has no lead (PublicShare.hasLead). On a lead's link the task reads 'Call on the lead’s number, 9688 2109.' and the phone never reaches the page. The due time comes from callBackDue: within the hour on weekdays 09:00–17:00 SGT, 10:00 that day before nine, otherwise 10:00 the next weekday.
createShareLink sorts the snapshot by room position, then version order. fetchShare also sorts older links. joinWords (Intl.ListFormat) is provided for the h1 and the draft.
The snapshot freezes clientLabel ('Design 2 · Golden Hour') and clientRoom (' sketch' removed). PublicShare versions always carry both, derived for older links. The bell keeps the studio's own label.
PublicShare.now is the server clock at render.
Same as F104: PublicShare.now.

lead_events gets new kinds share_stopped, share_renewed and share_reopened, stamped with who acted. The hard-coded 'You stopped sharing' line stays only as a fallback, worded passively, for stops made before events existed. Each pin reply gets its own line. A render saved to Files reads 'saved … from the AI Visualizer to Files', and the folder it started reads accordingly.

Pins that were removed drop out of Activity. Deleting or restoring a design, room or version, and a Delete forever, now log events. A restore within 2 minutes (Undo) deletes the delete's line instead. The repair's unknown-event-kind check now lists every kind.

Server side: recordShareSent never replaces 'whatsapp' with 'copy', and is guarded by linkFor. ShareRow.ended lets the dialog show links that ended without a Stop. Copy/Open and the 'not sent yet' wording are UI.
New unstopShareLink(id) clears only revoked_at, so the original expiry stands, and removes the stop's Activity line. renewShareLink stays for Renew and returns expiresAt.
Same as F108: unstopShareLink.

A filed render gets its real size: the data URL's bytes, or the public file's size via fs.stat; the made-up 140 000 is gone. One naming helper, renderFileName/originalFileName, keeps 1.0's 'Render - {Room} - V{n}.jpg'. The render origin data feeds the Information panel. Repair sizes the demo files.

New visualizer_designs.source_lead_id. duplicateDesign sets it (copies of copies keep it). The gallery, designFor, the editor, the title and the image route all check Who sees leads against leadId ?? sourceLeadId.

duplicateDesign copies, in one transaction, every job with new ids: parents remapped, stored pictures and deleted versions kept so the V-numbers hold. It also copies the rooms' picks with their picture store and the live own swatches. Links, pins and client answers are not copied. It returns { id, rooms, renders } for the snackbar.

folderChangeBlockFor: an AI Visualizer folder can be renamed, moved or deleted (and a delete undone) only by its maker, an Owner or an Admin; anyone can still create one. Other libraries keep their rule. Enforced in folder-actions; a move keeps refused folders where they are and counts them as kept. Folders now carry createdBy and mayChange.
restoreDesigns, restoreStudioMaterials, restoreRoom and opening a deleted lead design no longer touch updatedAt, so Undo puts the card back where it was.

restoreDesigns checks Who sees leads, that the design is deleted, and designChangeBlock. restoreStudioMaterials checks materialChangeBlock and that the material is deleted. Both return { restored } | Err, and a single refused id returns the rule. deleteStudioMaterialsForever and emptyMaterialTrash return results too.

Guards added: restoreRoom (roomFor plus the rule), restorePin (pinFor, studio pins only), recordShareSent, renewShareLink and stopShareLink (linkFor → designFor: visible and not deleted), restoreStudioMaterials, and deleteDesignsForever (now also checks canOpenLead). Every one returns an { error } a person can read.

fileVersion finds a filed render by identity (lead_file_renders.render_key), never by name. A render filed before the record existed is recognised by its address, or by its picture plus name, and then linked. Renaming a room to a name another room has is refused (F083).

Removing an own swatch is now soft: it is marked removedAt and kept for a day. restoreOwnSwatch(designId, id) brings it back, and the old Undo path (saveOwnSwatch with the page's copy) also restores it with its picture instead of failing. parseOwn hides removed swatches, and the image route still serves them.

New project_rooms.assets_json store and saveRoomAsset(roomId, dataUrl) → { id, url: /visualizer/img/a/<room>/<id> }, content-hashed so the same picture gets the same address. saveRoomState moves any data URL in refs[].url or refImage into the store and returns their addresses, so state_json only ever holds addresses. The route gained kind 'a'. Repair lifts existing rows.

Guarded readers: parseJson, parseVariants (well-formed rows only, filled out), parseDetection (surfaces and furniture always arrays), parseComments, parseSnapshot, parseOwnStored and parseAssets. They are used in the queries, both action files, the image route and Activity. saveRoomState and addRoom check the detection's shape.

New render_images table (job_id + variant_id → data URL). saveRender stores pictures there and variants_json keeps only the address. Migration 0055 moves existing pictures in SQL; on the auditor DB it went from 2.6 MB to 20 KB. Repair R62 catches stragglers. fetchVisualizerEditor is wrapped in React cache() so metadata and page share one load, and visualizerTitle(designId) is a light title read.

Partial unique index visualizer_designs_lead_one_idx on (lead_id) where kind = 'lead'. The migration first folds any duplicates into the oldest, moving their rooms and links. openLeadDesign inserts with onConflictDoNothing and then re-selects, so three simultaneous first opens make one design.

Image routes gate every read. A studio read of /visualizer/img/* follows Who sees leads, including personal copies. A client read needs ?t=<token> of an open link that shows that picture (a live version or its before image), and is refused after Stop, design delete, lead return or delete, version delete, or expiry. fetchShare appends the token to every stored-picture address. /files/img is gated by lead visibility. All caching is private: 1 year immutable for the studio, 300 s for links. Public samples still redirect.
shareMeta(token) → { title, description, image, open } for WhatsApp previews. The image is the first live version's picture on the token and is null once the link is closed.

Lead lifecycle: links end while a lead is returned (return processing or approved) or deleted, judged at read time and reversible by Undo. Lost and On Hold keep their links. Filed renders keep their own picture after a design's Delete forever. A lead deleted for good leaves its personal copies visible only to Owners and Admins, because the source lead is gone.

Two tabs: project_rooms.state_rev. saveRoomState({ …, baseRev }) writes only on that revision, atomically, and otherwise returns { conflict: true, stateRev }. setRoomPhoto and undoRoomPhoto bump and return it. Two members: saveRender runs one Generate per room at a time through an in-process queue, so V-numbers can't collide. A retrying transaction was tried and dropped because it leaves a libsql lock behind.
Render pictures moved out of variants_json (see F213). R61 needs no picture rows because its renders are public paths. render_images and lead_file_renders were added to both baseline table lists.

partial.left: Nothing is needed server-side. REG-149's stand-in stays for undecodable files, as the verifier said. The fix is to re-encode small GIF/BMP files in the browser: readFileAsDataUrl in lib/templates/files.ts (owned by nobody, see crossFileRequests), called by lead-files.tsx (wave B) with { web: true }.

Server side done: the Files picture cap is now 12,000,000, under the 12 MB body limit, and cleanImage's 11,000,000 already fit. Still to do: always re-encode room photos to JPEG q0.9 at up to 1600 px (lib/templates/files.ts, see crossFileRequests), and in visualizer-editor.tsx (wave B) map a thrown body-limit error to 'That photo is over 10 MB — try a smaller one'.

skipped.why: UI only. createShareLink filing each shared version into Files › Renders is intended (Q-13) and unchanged. The missing piece is the dialog's line saying so, in share-dialog.tsx (wave B).

crossFileRequests.change: Use each folder's own rule. In the folder menu (around lines 472–475: Move, Rename, Delete), replace `F.block` with `const fb = menuFolder.mayChange !== undefined ? menuFolder.mayChange : F.block` for both `disabled` and the reason; per the sweep rule the reason should show as the row's meta, not a native title. registerLines: AI Visualizer · a room's delete follows its rule (F076, F202). A room is deleted or restored only by whoever made it, whoever made its design, an Owner or an Admin. The server refuses with 'Only whoever made it or its design, an Owner or an Admin can delete this room' (invented copy), and each room tells the menu why. Why: policy.ts already stated the rule but deleteRoom never applied it. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · every restore goes through its delete's door, and Undo puts things back where they were (F129, F204, F125). This covers restoring designs, rooms, pins and studio materials, and stopping, renewing or recording a share link. Each checks Who sees leads and the maker/Owner/Admin rule and returns a readable { error }. Restores leave updatedAt alone. Delete forever checks lead visibility too. Why: the server skipped the checks the UI implied. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · a client link ends when it should (F092, F195, F077, critic §4). A link stops when its design is deleted (Restore reopens it), when its lead is returned to Qanvast while the return is pending or approved, or when the lead is deleted. Lost and On Hold keep links open. It also stops when every version on it was deleted. A deleted version leaves the link, and the client can't answer on it. Every client write is refused with 'This link is no longer active — ask your designer for an updated one.' (invented copy). Why: the delete dialog promised 'Shared links stop working'. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · pictures are served only to who may see them (critic §1). /visualizer/img follows Who sees leads, including copies of a lead's design. A client's picture loads only through its open link's token (?t=), and never after a Stop, delete, return or expiry. /files/img follows the lead. Caching is private only. Why: the addresses were public and cached for a year. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · pictures live beside their records (F213, F200, critic §22). Render pictures moved into render_images, and variants_json keeps only addresses; migration 0055 moved existing ones (2.6 MB → 20 KB on a test DB). Reference and piece photos go into the room's own store (/visualizer/img/a/…), so autosaves and pages carry addresses only. The editor's page and title share one load per request. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · a render saved to Files is itself (F093, F095, F194, F113). New lead_file_renders records which version each filed render is, found by identity and never by name. Files can offer 'Open this version' and name its origin, and renders are no longer offered as room photos. The file keeps its own copy of the picture, so it survives the design's Delete forever, and the lead's Activity keeps a line. Real sizes replace the made-up 137 KB. One file name is used for Files and downloads, 1.0's 'Render - {Room} - V{n}.jpg'. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · Add to a quote quotes what the version shows (F096, F097, F100, F101). Lines come from the version's cumulative finishes, so a relit version quotes its walls, floor and sofa. There is one line per surface group and finish. Each is priced from the Price book item its studio material names, else an item of the same name, else S$0; no category rates. No internal wording prints. The same version in the same draft twice is refused ('V2 is already in that quote.', invented copy) unless the studio adds it again. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · the bell and Activity open what they are about (F098). A client's favourite, note, pin or reply opens the design on its room and version, and on the pin itself. The demo's bell entries were updated by repair R62. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · Ask for a call back (F099). A number is required only on a link with no lead behind it. On a lead's link the Follow-up task says 'Call on the lead’s number, 9688 2109.' (invented copy) without the number reaching the page. The task is due within the hour in working hours (weekdays 09:00–17:00 SGT), otherwise at 10:00 the next working morning, never at 3 a.m. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · the client's link reads as the client's (F102, F103, F104, F209). Versions appear in the design's order, not the order they were ticked. Each has a client title, 'Design 2 · Golden Hour' (invented copy); the studio's shorthand stays in the bell. Rooms lose ' sketch'. Pin times count from the server's clock. WhatsApp preview data comes from shareMeta: title, a line on what's inside, and the first design's picture, only while the link is open (critic §2, invented copy). Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix / invented copy).

AI Visualizer · Activity tells the visualizer's story truly (F106, F207). Stopping, renewing and reopening a link are logged and name who did it. Deleting and restoring a design, room or version are logged, as is Delete forever. An Undo within two minutes removes the delete's line instead. Pin replies get their own line. Removed pins drop out. A render saved to Files reads 'saved … from the AI Visualizer to Files', not 'uploaded'. All sentences are invented copy. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · Stop sharing's Undo puts the link back as it was (F108, F208, F107). New unstopShareLink clears the stop and keeps the original expiry; Renew stays for 7 more days. Recording 'copied' never hides that a link went on WhatsApp. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · Duplicate copies the work and follows the client's privacy (F115, F116). A copy brings every version with its pictures, parents and numbers, plus the rooms' picks and the design's own swatches. It never copies links, pins or answers. A copy of a lead's design keeps that lead as its source, so only members who may see the lead see the copy. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · folders (F124, refines REG-673). Anyone makes an AI Visualizer folder. Only its maker, an Owner or an Admin renames, moves or deletes it: 'Only whoever made the folder, an Owner or an Admin can rename, move or delete it' (invented copy). Source: audit 2026-09-26 (user-directed rule refinement per the verifier).

AI Visualizer · room rename, Change photo and swatch Undo (F083, F090, F198). A room can't take another room's name, and names past 60 characters (designs: 80) are refused, not cut. Change photo keeps the room as it was, so its Undo brings back the photo, a sample's own reading and the picks. Removing a design's swatch is soft, so Undo returns it with its picture. Source: audit 2026-09-26 (bug fix).

AI Visualizer · one lead design, two tabs, two members (F215, critic §9). A unique index keeps one design per lead; the migration folds any duplicates, and simultaneous first opens land on one design.
